title: ID0424631-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2 / P7 312547889/04 ] Chargers received errors
description:
Reported issue: We had some authorisation issues during the night 14/05/2025. Chargers received errors for the StartTransaction request sent by chargers. PLC has communication error with AC meter
Solution: Update to v8.X
R&D ticket EVC3-9423

Hello Bastien, good morning.
Thank you for the report.
I can see the error, I will confirm why this error occurred and come back to you. I found the exact same issue yesterday in another and after a reboot it's back to operation without any problem. Please do a reboot if you haven't and as soon as I have an official reply I will convey it to you.
Thank you for your patience.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0424631-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2 / P7 312547889/04 ] Chargers received errors CRM:02684000247
additional_info.body:
Hello Bastien, good afternoon.
For this problem we have a fix in v8.X which is estimated to come out in CW27.
Until then, we just need to perform a reboot if the error appears, or wait until the error is gone. I checked some other chargers and it only happens for a few seconds and recovers.
If you need a solution as soon as possible I request you to reach out to Jessica Mina to speed up the process.
I will close the ticket since our solution is provided.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
